items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes Aug 31 Product post: “A milestone in expanding access to AI”
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 於 8/31 新聞頁刊出產品文：〈擴大 AI 取用的里程碑〉
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s official News page dated a Product item “A milestone in expanding access to AI” to August 31, 2026, placing it above earlier Aug 28 company posts on Cursor/SpaceX and Thailand startups. The listing is live on openai.com/news; the full article body was not independently retrievable from a stable public slug at digest time.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方 News 將產品類文章〈A milestone in expanding access to AI〉標為 2026-08-31，排序高於 8/28 的 Cursor／SpaceX 與泰國新創相關公司文。條目可見於 openai.com/news；消化當下未能從穩定公開網址讀到全文。
items_flat.analysis_en: The date stamp is official and new for this Taipei calendar day, but without a readable body the scope—product, pricing, geography, or partnership—remains unverified. Treat the headline as confirmed listing, not a decoded launch.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 日期戳為官方且屬本日新條目，但在讀不到正文前，無法判定是產品、定價、地區或合作。標題可確認，內容不可臆測。

items_flat.title_en: GPT-5.4 leaves Codex for ChatGPT-signed-in users as of August 31
items_flat.title_zh: 自 8 月 31 日起，以 ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 不再提供 GPT-5.4
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI Developers previously announced that GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini would no longer be available for users signed in with ChatGPT starting August 31. The same notice said the models remain available on the OpenAI API and in Codex sessions authenticated with an API key.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI Developers 先前宣布：自 8 月 31 日起，以 ChatGPT 帳號登入的使用者將無法在 Codex 使用 GPT-5.4 與 GPT-5.4 mini。同則說明指出，這兩款模型仍可透過 OpenAI API，以及以 API key 驗證的 Codex 工作階段使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a channel sunset, not a company-wide model death: ChatGPT-login Codex is forced onto the 5.6 family, while API customers can keep 5.4. Teams that hardcoded 5.4 inside ChatGPT-auth Codex need a migration check today.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路下線而非全平台除役：ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 被推向 5.6 家族，API 客戶仍可留在 5.4。若工作流把 5.4 寫死在 ChatGPT 驗證的 Codex，今天就要檢查遷移。
items_flat.quote: GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini will no longer be available for users signed in with ChatGPT starting August 31. The models will remain available on the OpenAI API and Codex sessions authenticated with an API key.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自 8 月 31 日起，以 ChatGPT 登入的使用者將無法使用 GPT-5.4 與 GPT-5.4 mini。這兩款模型仍可在 OpenAI API，以及以 API key 驗證的 Codex 工作階段使用。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral retires Medium 3 and Medium 3.1; docs point to Medium 3.5
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 正式淘汰 Medium 3 與 3.1，文件改指向 Medium 3.5
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral’s official models documentation lists retirement on August 31, 2026 for Mistral Medium 3 (`mistral-medium-2505`) and Mistral Medium 3.1 (`mistral-medium-2508`). The documented replacement for both is Mistral Medium 3.5.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 官方模型文件將 Mistral Medium 3（`mistral-medium-2505`）與 Medium 3.1（`mistral-medium-2508`）的 Retirement 日期列為 2026-08-31。兩者建議替代模型皆為 Mistral Medium 3.5。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cutoff consolidates Mistral’s mid-tier API onto a single current SKU. Integrations still calling the 2505/2508 IDs should fail or be rejected after today unless a hidden compatibility alias remains unpublished.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 中階 API 被收斂到單一現役 SKU。若整合仍呼叫 2505／2508 識別碼，今日之後應會失敗或被拒，除非另有未公開相容別名。
items_flat.quote: Mistral Medium 3.1 … 5/22/2026 8/31/2026 … Mistral Medium 3.5; Mistral Medium 3 … 5/22/2026 8/31/2026 … Mistral Medium 3.5
items_flat.quote_zh: Mistral Medium 3.1……淘汰日 2026-08-31……改用 Mistral Medium 3.5；Mistral Medium 3……淘汰日 2026-08-31……改用 Mistral Medium 3.5

brief_en: A quiet window: no flagship model launches. OpenAI listed a new Product post on expanding AI access and, as scheduled, dropped GPT-5.4 from ChatGPT-signed Codex. Mistral retired Medium 3/3.1 in favor of Medium 3.5. Anthropic, Google, Meta, and xAI had no new official lab posts in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: 平靜窗口：無旗艦模型發表。OpenAI 新聞頁新增「擴大 AI 取用」產品文，並依既定時程自 ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 下線 GPT-5.4。Mistral 正式淘汰 Medium 3/3.1，改指向 Medium 3.5。Anthropic、Google、Meta、xAI 近 12 小時無新官方宣布。
